notes.title: Storyteller's Festival 2024
notes.content:
The second edition of Steam's [b]Storyteller's Festival[/b] hosted by Two and a Half Studios is here and we're happy to be a part of it again!  

We invite you to join us and other amazing devs, and get our games at discount this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SCdE69c.png[/img]

notes.title: VISUAL NOVEL FEST + MYSTERY GAMEDEV ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Blankspace is taking part in the Visual Novel Fest!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TRRitXe.png[/img]

But that's not all!

Today we have a MAJOR announcement!

During the past two months we've been working with other mystery game developers to form a community where we can learn and grow together.

We call this community Mystery Gamedev!

[url=https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA][img]https://i.imgur.com/uSwScwv.png[/img][/url]

We're just getting started, but we already have 15+ developers of popular mystery games, with hundreds of positive reviews and thousands of players each.

We'd like to invite everyone who enjoys mystery games -- fans, developers, and content creators -- to join!

Mystery games span many genres, and include highly popular games such as Ace Attorney, Danganronpa, Zero Escape, and many more!

If you'd like to discover new and upcoming mystery games from indie devs, or learn how to create your own, then come and join our Discord server!

Join the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA]https://discord.gg/GUe3KYWufA[/url]

Learn More: [url=https://mysterygamedev.com]https://mysterygamedev.com[/url]

notes.title: Achievement art update + Steam Cloud enabled!
notes.content:
We've updated the achievement icons for Blankspace with new art, hope you like them! :)

Additionally, Steam Cloud saves are now enabled! Your existing saves will stay local, but any saves you make after this update will be saved to the cloud, too.

- Nayru

notes.title: Blankspace Release Date - July 23rd!
notes.content:
Make sure to add Blankspace to your Steam wishlist so that you don't miss it! Those 7 days will pass by faster than you think!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lM2jh9z.png[/img]

After working diligently on this project for over a year (the first ideas blossomed in April 2019, while Beryl and Chris's designs came into existence in June/July 2019), I am super excited to share this project in its complete form with you and the rest of the world.

[previewyoutube=tPafLBCMjhg;full][/previewyoutube]
You can also join us on [url=https://twitter.com/NoBreadStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/5SpaXFm]Discord[/url] for more frequent updates!

Cheers!
- Nayru
